notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate: one rich secondary (Lighthouse Friends) plus Department of Marine reports and heritage register texts. Report entries (notes 2, 3, 4) are OCR'd multi-column tables; the Langara rows were matched by position in the column (notes 3 and 4 especially: the 30-foot tower row and the 'Installation of a derrick' row). The 1914 report says 30 ft, the heritage register 7.6 m (25 ft): stated as disagreement in the text. Derrick 1915/tramway 1917 dates are Lighthouse Friends'; the corpus's report volumes are dated by the fiscal year ending March of the following year (note 4 assumed FY to March 1916, note 5 FY to March 1918). Keeper roster is from Lighthouse Friends only (no USLHS for Canada); Wikipedia's list differs slightly (Kenneth Brunn vs Burn; omits Westhead, Botham). Federal Heritage Building 7824 (1997) page could not be read, only the CRHP 9496 text. LF says single dwelling built 1959; the register dates dwellings 1962/1965. Kinnear account is an oral interview with daughters. No named wrecks found; USCG/newspaper steps skipped for Canada. Fact-check 2026-10-27: fiscal years in notes 2-5 corrected (volume labelled by session year; 1913v47 = FY 1911-12, 1914v48 = FY 1912-13, 1916v51 = FY 1914-15, 1918v53 = FY 1916-17). Report of FY Mar 1912 shows work already under way, earlier than Lighthouse Friends' 1912 start. Chance Heritage Trust page largely copies Lighthouse Friends, so is not independent.
